Maya Patel: Quick sync — we have inconsistent client-facing text for quota vs capacity vs internal fallbacks across API and Console. Can we agree a small set of canonical messages?
Samir Khan: +1. Is the ask just wording or payload shape too?
Maya Patel: Both. Console shows human copy, API returns opaque codes. We should standardize message, code, and optional hint fields (retry, quota_id, fallback_model).
Oliver Reed: For status mapping I propose: 4xx = client action (bad request, invalid key, quota), 429 = rate/quota with retry-after, 503 = temporary capacity fallback (include reason), 5xx = internal error w/ ticket id.
Irene Zhang: Agree on mapping. Also prefer returning a machine-friendly `error_code` string plus a user-facing `message`. e.g. `{
  "error_code": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "Quota exceeded: upgrade or retry in 30s",
  "retry_after": 30
}`
Samir Khan: Can we avoid leaking internal routing policy names in message? e.g., don't return "migrate-to-spot" or internal pool ids. Use abstract reasons: "capacity constrained" or "rate limit".
Maya Patel: Yes — no internal ids in `message`. Put any internal debug ids in a separate header or `meta.debug_id` that is only returned when `X-Debug: true` is set.
Oliver Reed: UX question: should Console show the exact same text we send in the API? I think Console can be friendlier but should map directly to the canonical message so customers don't see contradictory info.
Irene Zhang: +1. Also add a short `action` field for suggestions: values like ["retry","reduce_batch","upgrade_plan","contact_support","fallback_model_used"]. That helps automated client UX.
Samir Khan: Example error payload suggestion (final):
```json
{
  "error_code": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "Quota exceeded for project. Retry after 30s or upgrade plan.",
  "action": "retry",
  "retry_after": 30,
  "documentation_url": "https://console.redwood.ai/docs/errors#quota_exceeded"
}
```
Maya Patel: Love it. Who owns the canonical copy and doc link? We should add to API spec and Console copy repo.
Oliver Reed: I can own updating the API spec. Will PR a small table mapping status -> error_code -> suggested message.
Irene Zhang: I'll update the Console copy repo to reference that table and adjust UI tooltips.
Samir Khan: I'll wire telemetry: ensure we tag metrics with `error_code`, `model_variant`, and `routing_policy` (but keep the latter out of client message).
deploy-bot: Deployed to staging: api-spec/errors.md updated branch `oliver/error-codes` (build #342) :rocket:
Maya Patel: Thanks all — next steps: Oliver PR, Irene Console update, Samir telemetry. Follow up in #eng-platform if any blockers. :thumbsup:
